name: n8n-as-code-vs-native-mcp-benchmark
description: Benchmark harness comparing n8n-as-code and n8n Native MCP for AI-driven workflow generation
prompt: build a multi agent n8n workflow to check daily Google mails and calendar, triage data, and present an html dashboard of the day

metrics.name: Ease of Installation
metrics.description: Documentation clarity, setup steps, prerequisite complexity, setup time, friction events

metrics.name: Ease of Use
metrics.description: Ergonomics, interaction turns, schema feedback loop, error recovery, cognitive load

metrics.name: Token Consumption
metrics.description: Input prompt tokens, output tokens, total tokens, tool call overhead

metrics.name: Time to Create Workflow
metrics.description: Wall-clock time from initial prompt to verified workflow deployed

expectedCapabilities.name: Multi-agent architecture (real LangChain agent nodes with a language model pinned)

requirements.capabilityNote: Scored by benchmark/harness/scoring.mjs on node types and wiring only, never on node names, equal share each. Builders are never shown this list.
